_comment: Human review-rejected records excluded at export (mapping_id -> entry). The frozen checkpoints and audit trails keep the full record; only the shipped export excludes the row, and supplementary.json discloses every applied drop. Entries matching no record in a given run are ignored (this file is shared by fixture-scale and corpus-scale exports).

drops.reason: Mapping Rationale asserts data-transfer scope the quoted provision does not state (generic foreign-entity registration boilerplate, s. 359(2)); mapper overreach, no score path (SG 6.4 scores via PDPA s. 26(1)).
